thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — hosted runtime reporting repeated OOMs in kv-cache worker pool. High memory growth observed correlated with long user prompts and continuous-batching spikes. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/incident/3923456789

alex: I'm on it. seeing OOMs on 3 workers in eu-west-1, container restarts ~ every 30s. allocating >90% GPU mem then OOM.

maya: thanks alex. can you drop recent logs (kv-cache, batching) and the prefetch metrics? suspect prefetch + continuous batching interaction.

alex: pasted last 200 lines: ```
E 14:02:11 kv_cache.cpp:452 PrefetchWindow grew to 2.6M entries for session s-7f9
E 14:02:11 batching.cpp:301 BatchController: batch_size=512 queued=1024 latency=120ms
E 14:02:12 runtime: oom when allocating 1.2GB for kvcache segment
```

sam: hmm batch_size=512 queued=1024 — that's a red flag. default max_batch_size was 256 in config, looks like controller drifted after the rollout. any recent config change?

chris: I rolled a minor controller tweak yesterday to "aggressively pack" small requests for perf; it bumped `max_concurrent_batches` and the heuristics. rolling back is possible but needs a quick hotfix.

liz: heads up — ticket #C-4122 (enterprise customer) showing elevated 500s and truncated completions since ~13:58. CS is waiting for ETA on mitigation.

alex: mitigation idea: 1) reduce continuous-batching max_window to 256ms and cap batch_size at 128; 2) temporarily disable prefetch for sessions with tokens > 8k; 3) restart affected workers one-by-one after env changes.

ops-bot: Rolling config change v2026.3: set `batch_controller.max_batch_size=128`, `batch_controller.max_window_ms=256` for hosted-runtime eu-west-1. Applying to pool `hosted-runtime-kv-1` now.

maya: I approve. Doing a targeted deploy to the pool. We'll also add a guard to prefetch: `prefetch.max_kv_entries_per_session=200000` to avoid runaway growth.

alex: after change, OOMs stopped on two workers, one still restarting occasionally. memory usage dropped from 95% -> ~68% on most nodes. latency spikes reduced.

sam: good. we should also patch the packer heuristic so it doesn't create huge batches when session window contains large key ranges. Chris, can you prepare a hotpatch?

chris: will push a small hotfix to the packer tonight: "do not combine sessions if any session length > 6k tokens". I'll open PR and mark as urgent.

joel: customer comms: Liz, can you confirm impacted customers + severity? Should we offer compensation / explain temporary throttling?

liz: impacted: C-4122 (major), C-4130 (minor), and some anonymous traffic — roughly 0.15% of overall requests. C-4122 had several long-prompt jobs that triggered the prefetchoverflow. Support message drafted: "We've mitigated an issue causing memory pressure and partial failures for very long prompts; we've reduced batching aggressiveness and applied limiters. We'll follow up with root cause and permanent fix."

alex: note — we saw a specific pattern: prompt sequences with repeated prefix embeddings caused KV index amplification (prefix being re-inserted repeatedly). Might be a prefix caching bug + packer heuristics.

maya: adding instrument: `kv.prefetch_key_duplication_rate` to detect prefix amplification. We'll ship metric within the hour.

sam: for on-call handoff: current status: config rolled, OOMs mostly resolved, one flaky worker under observation. Running 30m stabilization window. Next oncall should watch prefetch growth and packer queue depth.

ops-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2. Pager quieting rule applied for eu-west-1 (thresholds increased temporarily to avoid noise during mitigation).

alex: okay starting stabilization, will leave logs and traces in /incidents/3923456789. If no recurrence by +30m I'll mark as mitigated.

chris: PR #9876 opened: small packer guard + unit tests. tagging maya for review. Deploy to canary now.

maya: canary looks clean on 2 nodes. metrics: batch_size p50 dropped from 180 -> 96, prefetch entries rate down 4x.

liz: updated customers and escalations: C-4122 accepted interim mitigation, wants timeline for permanent fix. Asked for postmortem.

sam: action items for followup: 1) postmortem w/ timeline and RCA (owner: maya); 2) backfill metrics for prefix-duplication (owner: alex); 3) permanent packer fix + gradual rollout (owner: chris); 4) add prefetch circuit-breaker for hosted (owner: eng-runtime).

joel: also add runbook step: if kv-cache mem >85% and batch_size >300, immediately cap batch controller and set `prefetch.disabled=true` for offending sessions.

alex: handoff to night oncall @sam_night — everything in the incident channel, watchlist pinned.

sam: taking handoff. please paste the command to toggle prefetch quickly in case it flares up again.

maya: quick toggle command: ```
# disable prefetch for session class large-prompts
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags \
  -d '{"key":"prefetch.disabled_for_large_prompts","value":true}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

alex: leaving logs + short summary in the thread. tagging incident-bot to create incident ticket and assign to postmortem board.

incident-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-3923456789 and linked to postmortem board: https://pm.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-3923456789

sam: thanks. I'll monitor overnight and escalate if anything returns. Good work team. :thumbsup:
